recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. If a future '?ext' rendering problem appears, investigate the current IG Publisher/rendering toolchain rather than changing FHIR specification source solely for this old applied issue.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core DSTU2 change request asking that profile Terminology Bindings tables stop showing '?ext' for inherited Patient bindings such as Patient.meta.tag and Patient.language when the relevant core value sets have resolvable names available to the IG builder.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites SVN revision 13538. In git history this is 2258ecebd500cd3513ac23a691febbadd4f0e879, 'GF#12787 - fix bindings links', which changed the old in-repository IG tooling and FHIR page processor terminology-binding rendering to resolve value set URLs rather than leaving the name column at the '?ext' fallback.
additional_context: The current FHIR checkout no longer contains the old tools/java StructureDefinitionRenderer or PageProcessor code changed by the 2018 application commit. Current build inputs still include Patient, Resource, and Meta; Resource.language is bound to the named all-languages value set, and Meta.tag is bound through the Meta datatype spreadsheet to valueset-common-tags. The only Patient-derived profile source found under source/profiles is cda.profile.xml, and it is commented out in source/fhir.ini. Zulip and Confluence searches found no later conflicting discussion or reversal.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source change is needed because the issue was applied historically, current source inputs provide resolvable value set names for the cited inherited bindings, and current source contains no '?ext' fallback text.
